config.variance_convention: s and tau2 are variances; each real/imag coordinate has variance s/2 for proper-complex sensor noise
config.coordinates: Canonical X=e1 and Q=[e2,e3]; vec_F Z (real), [Re vec_F Z, Im vec_F Z] (complex)
config.independence: Independent datasets and independent snapshots within a dataset; same dataset prefixes across L and same underlying Gaussian draws across sensor variances are common random numbers. Cells are correlated, not extra independent replications.
config.interpretation: Expected total information is L times the one-snapshot Fisher matrix. Monte Carlo error is estimated across independent datasets. The L axis counts observations in each dataset, never simulation episodes or posterior draws.
config.selection: All fields, variances, counts, seeds and precision diagnostics are frozen before the paper run; statistical failures remain visible.
